Kon Knueppel led the Hornets with 29 points (11-19 FG, 3-7 3PT), 4 rebounds and 3 assists.
CLE won 2 of 4 factors: ball security, getting to the line. Effective FG% 46.3 to 52.6.
Biggest swing: Brandon Miller makes 32-foot three point pullup jump shot (Sion James assists) (Q4 4.7), −30 points of CLE win probability.
Best CLE lineup (4+ minutes): Ball, Mitchell, Bryant, Tomlin, Tyson, +1 in 6:48.
Bench points: CLE 41, CHA 29. Points in the paint: 48–50. Second-chance points: 8–21.
